responses.value: Buy the printer. It costs $250,000 and saves about $70,000 a year in outsourced milling, so it pays back in about 3.6 years, well within its 7-year life. It also cuts crown turnaround from 10 days to 4, which helps win dentists' business. The main risk is that the savings assume today's crown volume, and two technicians lose three weeks to training. The next step is to confirm next year's crown orders with our largest dentists and price a service contract before signing.
Hold. It still cuts turnaround from 10 days to 4, and we make 6,000 crowns a year. Buy the printer.
